title: REMISSION
notes: Dr. Adrian Hale made a cure for cancer. Then the patients died, and got back up. Wake up in Halcyon Biotech nine days later.
An open city to explore: towers, streets of wrecks, a police precinct, St. Agnes Hospital, your apartment, the park, the army checkpoint.
Five guns: semi-auto pistol, SMG, automatic rifle, a scoped sniper rifle that goes through three of them, and a heavy minigun torn off a helicopter.
A day and night cycle: by night the fast ones come out, and things happen in the dark. Jump scares, whispers on the radio, and something small that follows you.
A gore slider from 0 to 100: no blood at all, up to limbs coming off and heads bursting.
Eight chapters, a boss, notes and tapes to find, two endings. Controllers, touch, and installable as an app.
